title: Tony Almerico's band on the boat
summary: He recalls a strong wartime band with Almerico, with Fazola and Lester Bouchon.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I played with Tony Amarica on the boat during the war too. Boy we had a heck of a band. Very good band. Lester Bouchon, Shorty Reese, Fazola and myself on saxophones. I played alto on that job too. I played lead and Fazola played third alto and Bouchon and Shorty Reese played the tenors. And Bobby Castleglough played trombone. And Red Bowman played trumpet and Howard Reed on trumpet. Alec Coulon on bass, Joe Salvaggio on piano, and Abbey Brunish, the one that died, played drums.
Boy was it a fine band. Really, really was it. That was a fine drummer too.
